title: Coral Candy Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Vibrant Multicolour Foliage
description:
Stunning Coleus with Coral, Maroon & Green Hues for Sun or Shade!


KEY FEATURES
• Unique multicoloured foliage with coral, maroon, and green shades
• Compact, mounded growth habit, perfect for containers and small spaces
• Vibrant colour holds well in both full sun and shade
• Award-winning variety (2023 Ornamental Seed Winner)
• Low maintenance with foliage as the main attraction


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides
Colour: Coral pink, maroon, green
Season: Summer to frost
Growth Habit: Mounded


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun or full shade
Soil: Any type of well-draining soil
Watering: Water regularly, keep soil moist but not waterlogged
Spacing: 8-10 inches (20-25 cm)
Height: 10-16 inches (25-41 cm)
Spread: 12-14 inches (30-36 cm)
Hardiness: USDA Zone 9 (Frost tender)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in frost-free conditions; suitable for indoor or outdoor cultivation.
• Water regularly, especially during hot, dry periods, ensuring soil remains moist.
• Feed regularly with a balanced fertiliser during the growing season to promote healthy foliage.
• Maintain moderate humidity levels; remove developing flower spikes to encourage vigorous foliage growth.
• Can tolerate full sun in regions with high relative humidity; foliage may scorch in full sun with low humidity.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
